Coffee Outside

Knoxville, TN · Old City · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-dropFamily

Coffee Outside is a social group ride in Knoxville, TN. It rolls monthly, on a Sunday at 9:00 am from Two Bikes. Pace: slow. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Coffee Outside group ride

A short, slow ride to the Gay Street Bridge to make coffee outside. Bring a stove and a mug if you have them; the shop brings extras if you don't. Once a month on a Sunday morning.
